what_this_does_not_say: No DT was re-evaluated: every transferred-DT cell is READ from its committed artifact (P7.3a, P7.3b, P7.3d, P7.3c) and only rho's two anchors change between the pairs; the registered rho and the registered H3 verdicts stand as the record, and every value under a new pair is reported beside them, never in their place.

The new anchors are a CONTROL added after the results (A27(a), item 5): a MaxPressure whose pressure counts each lane once per phase, and the equal-split fixed-time plan at CityFlow's tuned k rendered in SUMO exactly as the registered k = 4 anchor was; neither is a tuned SUMO controller.

departLane is set nowhere in the parity route files (DEFERRED 116), so SUMO's default departure lane applies on every SUMO cell, registered and new alike; it is not changed here and it is a named limitation.
rho is computed within SUMO on SUMO's own anchors; the CityFlow maxpressure_1to1 cells are reported beside the registered CityFlow anchors and enter no transferred-DT rho.
